description.value: Surfside Grill is a takeout-focused seafood and burger restaurant located within Tsawaak RV Resort and Campground on Tofino's Pacific Rim Highway, founded by commercial fisherman Jeff Mikus. The menu leans heavily on fresh local seafood — fish tacos, chowder, oysters, and salmon burgers — sourced with the owner's direct knowledge of the BC fishing industry. A licensed patio serves local beers, ciders, and wines, and the site is accessible via a beach path from Mackenzie Beach.
